name: Ryoumaden ~Houkago no Rakuen~
source:
One day, Koji sees Akemi, his classmate, changing her clothes at the classroom. Chiaki, Akemi's close friend, comes into the classroom and blames him...

Since then, Koji is disliked by all classmates... Koji gets mad and decides to revenge on Akemi and Chiaki...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
有一天，浩司看到他的同学明美正在教室换衣服。明美的好朋友千秋走进教室责怪他……

从此以后，浩司被全班同学讨厌……浩司生气了，决定向明美和千秋报仇……

[来自工口游戏商店]
